source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(3)1)e「使用者の整備及び改造の義務」（教則表示ページ22 / PDF viewer 27）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 登録無人航空機の使用者は、安全上の登録適格性と登録記号表示を継続的に維持する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 機体登録は取得時だけの要件であり、登録後に安全性が低下しても登録記号さえ残っていればよい。
evidence.reasoning_path: registered aircraft in service -> continuing safety eligibility + marking -> maintenance duty

collision.note: Tier A。Q102は登録拒否となる初期条件、Q108は登録情報変更を問う。本問は登録後の継続的な安全適格性・表示維持義務を問う。

independent_review.rationale: 3.1.2(3)1)e explicitly imposes continuing duties on the user of a registered UAS to preserve safety eligibility and registration-mark display. Q102 concerns initial registration refusal and Q108 registration-data changes, not post-registration maintenance of eligibility and marking.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the quality-preserving 400-question contract to the B7 Chapter 3 Rules set. All 15 Tier A candidates test explicit source propositions not represented by the current 215-question accepted/source-verified canonical bank. The five Tier B candidates C001, C003, C008, C013 and C015 remain materially distinct through source-defined flight-phase, authority/exception, operation-subtype, response-sequence or moving-vehicle boundaries. None is retained as wording-only variation, none relies on a subsection marked 〔一等〕, and none is accepted merely to fill a numeric quota.
